anim-lede.text: Each following slide pair demonstrates one family of transitions. Present this deck to watch them run.

example-animation-s1.notes: Slides are keyframes: an element keeps its id across slides and playback interpolates between its states.

example-animation-s2.notes: Eight scalar transition groups, all on `ease`.

example-animation-s3.notes: The transition is stored on the target keyframe.

example-animation-s4.notes: Nothing is visible yet: every element below is hidden on this keyframe.

example-animation-s5.notes: Each shape appears with its own visibility easing. `create` traces the outline; `extend` grows the path along its own route.

example-animation-s6.notes: controlPoints interpolates the vertex list; startArrow/endArrow fade heads in and out.

example-animation-s7.notes: Same element, different vertices and heads.

example-animation-s8.notes: Four copies of the same source image, fully framed.

example-animation-s9.notes: Each crop tightens onto a different cell of the grid, with a different crop easing.

example-animation-s10.notes: resource transitions cross-fade between two different images on the same element.

example-animation-s11.notes: `dissolve` cross-fades; `fadeinout` fades out to nothing and back in.
